{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Ambitious''''' was a supply ship captained by [[Vin Freen]]. It was reported by [[Imperial HoloVision]] to have crashed into the [[B'Knos]] colony due to its navigation systems crashing. The crash was reported to have [[Death/Legends|killed]] all the residents of the colony. In fact, the colony was attacked by the [[Ssi-ruu]] who took all the inhabitants for [[entechment]].
